--- title: "AmphibiaWeb lists 1,170 native frog species in Brazil. It has written accounts for 233." subtitle: "In 13 of the 15 largest national lists, 18–30% of recorded native species have an AmphibiaWeb account; Madagascar and Australia stand apart." description: "Fill-level squares show that AmphibiaWeb has written accounts for 233 of Brazil's 1,170 native frog species, and for 18–30% of species in 13 of the 15 largest national lists. Native lists exclude introduced countries and ambiguous country codes, and a species counts in every country where it occurs. Built in R with ggplot2, ggtext and showtext." date: "2026-10-12" author: - name: "Steven Ponce" url: "https://stevenponce.netlify.app" citation: url: "https://stevenponce.netlify.app/data_visualizations/TidyTuesday/2026/tt_2026_41.html" categories: ["TidyTuesday", "2026"] tags: [ "TidyTuesday", "AmphibiaWeb", "Amphibians", "Frogs", "Biodiversity", "Data Coverage", "Proportional Squares", "Part-to-Whole", "Small Multiples", "Country Comparison", "ggtext", "showtext", "ggplot2", "2026" ] image: "thumbnails/tt_2026_41.png" format: html: toc: true toc-depth: 5 code-link: true code-fold: true code-tools: true code-summary: "Show code" editor_options: chunk_output_type: inline execute: freeze: true cache: true error: false message: false warning: false eval: true --- ![AmphibiaWeb has written accounts for 233 of the 1,170 native frog species it lists for Brazil (20%). A 15-square grid, one per country with at least 250 native species, runs from the largest list to the smallest; each square's area shows the number of native species, and a burgundy fill rising from the bottom shows the share with an account. In 13 of the 15 countries, the share sits between 18% and 30%; Madagascar (274 of 441, 62%) and Australia (221 of 258, 86%) stand apart. An account means a description, life-history, or distribution text on AmphibiaWeb; a missing account does not mean a species lacks published research. Species found in several countries count in each list, so lists cannot be added together. Introduced occurrences and 31 species with ambiguous country codes are excluded. Source: AmphibiaWeb via TidyTuesday 2026 week 41.](tt_2026_41.png){#fig-1} ### [**Steps to Create this Graphic**]{.mark} #### [1. Load Packages & Setup]{.smallcaps} ::: {.cell} ````{.cell-code} ```{{r}} #| label: load #| warning: false #| message: false #| results: "hide" ## 1. LOAD PACKAGES & SETUP ---- suppressPackageStartupMessages({ if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman") pacman::p_load( tidyverse, ggtext, showtext, janitor, scales, glue, ggview, magick, countrycode ) }) # Source utility functions suppressMessages(source(here::here("R/utils/fonts.R"))) source(here::here("R/utils/social_icons.R")) source(here::here("R/utils/image_utils.R")) source(here::here("R/themes/base_theme.R")) ``` ```` ::: #### [2. Read in the Data]{.smallcaps} ::: {.cell} ````{.cell-code} ```{{r}} #| label: read #| include: true #| eval: true #| warning: false ### |- figure settings ---- fig_w <- 10 fig_h <- 10 ## 2. READ IN THE DATA ---- url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-10-13/frogs_and_toads_amphibiaweb.csv" frogs_raw <- readr::read_csv( url, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()), na = character() ) |> clean_names() ``` ```` ::: #### [3. Examine the Data]{.smallcaps} ::: {.cell} ````{.cell-code} ```{{r}} #| label: examine #| include: true #| eval: true #| results: 'hide' #| warning: false ## 3. EXAMINING THE DATA ---- glimpse(frogs_raw) skimr::skim(frogs_raw) ``` ```` ::: #### [4. Tidy Data]{.smallcaps} ::: {.cell} ````{.cell-code} ```{{r}} #| label: tidy #| warning: false frogs <- frogs_raw |> mutate( across(-c(isocc, intro_isocc), \(x) na_if(x, "NA")), intro_isocc = na_if(intro_isocc, "NA"), has_account = !is.na(description) | !is.na(life_history) | !is.na(distribution) ) intro <- frogs |> filter(!is.na(intro_isocc)) |> transmute(amphib_id, cc = str_split(str_remove_all(intro_isocc, " "), ",")) |> unnest(cc) |> filter(cc != "") |> mutate(introduced = TRUE) native <- frogs |> filter(isocc != "NA") |> select(amphib_id, has_account, isocc) |> mutate(cc = str_split(str_remove_all(isocc, " "), ",")) |> unnest(cc) |> filter(cc != "") |> left_join(intro, by = c("amphib_id", "cc")) |> filter(is.na(introduced)) |> distinct(amphib_id, cc, has_account) country <- native |> summarise(n = n_distinct(amphib_id), written = sum(has_account), .by = cc) |> mutate( share = written / n, pct = round(100 * share), name = countrycode(cc, "iso2c", "country.name", warn = FALSE) ) |> arrange(desc(n)) min_species <- 250 grid15 <- country |> filter(n >= min_species) n_ambiguous <- sum(frogs$isocc == "NA") br <- grid15 |> filter(cc == "BR") ## the 13-country band and the two exceptions band <- grid15 |> filter(pct <= 30) exceptions <- grid15 |> filter(pct > 30) |> arrange(desc(n)) band_rng <- range(band$pct) ``` ```` ::: #### [5. Visualization Parameters]{.smallcaps} ::: {.cell} ````{.cell-code} ```{{r}} #| label: params #| include: true #| warning: false ### |- plot aesthetics ---- col_paper <- "#f4f1ea" col_ink <- "#22282b" col_soft <- "#5c5f5b" col_rest <- "#e4ddd0" col_accent <- "#722F37" clrs <- get_theme_colors( palette = list(paper = col_paper, ink = col_ink, soft = col_soft, accent = col_accent) ) ### |- fonts ---- setup_fonts() fonts <- get_font_families() if (!"IBM Plex Mono" %in% sysfonts::font_families()) { sysfonts::font_add_google("IBM Plex Mono", "IBM Plex Mono") } title_family <- fonts$title_1 text_family <- fonts$text mono_family <- "IBM Plex Mono" ### |- titles and caption ---- title_text <- glue( "AmphibiaWeb lists {comma(br$n)} native frog species in {br$name}.
", "It has written accounts for {comma(br$written)}." ) subtitle_text <- glue( "In {nrow(band)} of the {nrow(grid15)} largest national lists, ", "{band_rng[1]}–{band_rng[2]}% of recorded native species have an ", "AmphibiaWeb account; {exceptions$name[1]} and {exceptions$name[2]} stand apart.", "

", "Each square is one country's list ", "of native frog species, largest first. Area shows how many are listed; the ", "height of the burgundy fill shows the share ", "with a written account." ) method_note <- glue( "Account = description, life history or distribution text on AmphibiaWeb; ", "no account does not mean no published research. Each country counts its ", "recorded native species (introduced countries removed); a species can appear ", "in several lists, so lists do not add up. Excludes {n_ambiguous} species whose ", "country code reads \"NA\" (Namibia's code, or missing). Countries with ", "≥ {min_species} native species." ) social <- create_social_caption( tt_year = 2026, tt_week = 41, source_text = "AmphibiaWeb (amphibiaweb.org)" ) caption_text <- glue( "{method_note}

{social}" ) ## Layout: one cell per country, 5 x 3. grid_cols <- 5 row_step <- 1.25 max_side <- 0.82 squares <- grid15 |> arrange(desc(n)) |> mutate( i = row_number() - 1, x0 = i %% grid_cols, y0 = -(i %/% grid_cols) * row_step, name_lab = if_else(nchar(name) > 13, str_replace(name, " (?=\\S+$)", "
"), name), side = sqrt(n / max(n)) * max_side, # outer AREA proportional to n level = side * share, # band HEIGHT proportional to share label = glue( "{name_lab}
", "{written} of {comma(n)} · {pct}%" ) ) # Brazil teaches the encoding once, in words only (its numbers sit below). br_sq <- squares |> filter(cc == "BR") key_labels <- tibble( x = br_sq$x0 + 0.025, y = c(br_sq$y0 + br_sq$side - 0.03, br_sq$y0 + br_sq$level / 2), label = c("without an account", "with an account"), color = c(col_soft, col_paper), vjust = c(1, 0.5) ) ### |- plot theme ---- base_theme <- create_base_theme(clrs) weekly_theme <- extend_weekly_theme( base_theme, theme( plot.background = element_rect(fill = col_paper, color = NA), panel.background = element_rect(fill = col_paper, color = NA), panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), plot.title = element_textbox_simple( family = title_family, color = col_ink, size = rel(1.55), lineheight = 1.1, margin = margin(b = 18) ), plot.subtitle = element_textbox_simple( family = text_family, color = col_ink, size = rel(1.0), lineheight = 1.3, margin = margin(b = 22) ), plot.caption = element_textbox_simple( family = text_family, color = col_soft, size = rel(0.62), lineheight = 1.3, margin = margin(t = 34) ), plot.title.position = "plot", plot.caption.position = "plot", plot.margin = margin(28, 32, 20, 32) ) ) theme_set(weekly_theme) ``` ```` ::: #### [6. Plot]{.smallcaps} ::: {.cell} ````{.cell-code} ```{{r}} #| label: plot #| warning: false ### |- main plot ---- p <- ggplot(squares) + geom_rect(aes(xmin = x0, xmax = x0 + side, ymin = y0, ymax = y0 + side), fill = col_rest, color = col_soft, linewidth = 0.3 ) + geom_rect(aes(xmin = x0, xmax = x0 + side, ymin = y0, ymax = y0 + level), fill = col_accent, color = NA ) + geom_text( data = key_labels, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label, color = color, vjust = vjust), hjust = 0, size = 2.9, family = text_family ) + scale_color_identity() + geom_richtext(aes(x = x0, y = y0 - 0.06, label = label), hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 3.4, lineheight = 1.15, family = text_family, color = col_ink, fill = NA, label.color = NA, label.padding = unit(0, "pt") ) + coord_equal(clip = "off") + labs(title = title_text, subtitle = subtitle_text, caption = caption_text) ``` ```` ::: ### [7. Save]{.smallcaps} ::: {.cell} ````{.cell-code} ```{{r}} #| label: save #| warning: false ### |- save ---- main_path <- here::here("data_visualizations", "TidyTuesday", "2026", "tt_2026_41.png") thumb_path <- here::here("data_visualizations", "TidyTuesday", "2026", "thumbnails", "tt_2026_41.png") # Full-size version, for the QMD figure ggview::save_ggplot( plot = p, file = main_path, width = fig_w, height = fig_h, units = "in", dpi = 320 ) # Reduced-size thumbnail, for the YAML `image:` field fs::dir_create(dirname(thumb_path)) magick::image_read(main_path) |> magick::image_resize("400") |> magick::image_write(thumb_path) ``` ```` ::: #### [8.
